reports.title: All tasks
reports.select_clause: title, TO_CHAR(start_date,  'Mon DD, YYYY' ) as "Start Date", TO_CHAR(end_date,  'Mon DD, YYYY' ) as "End Date", task_statuses.value as Status, (task_statuses.is_completing = false AND now() > tasks.end_date) AS "Is overdue"
reports.from_clause: tasks LEFT JOIN task_statuses ON tasks.task_status_id=task_statuses.id

reports.title: Tasks by assignee
reports.description: All tasks of the project by assignee
reports.select_clause: users.name as Assignee, tasks.title, TO_CHAR(tasks.start_date,'Mon DD, YYYY' ) as "Start Date", TO_CHAR(tasks.end_date,  'Mon DD, YYYY' ) as "End Date", task_statuses.value as Status, (task_statuses.is_completing = false AND now() > tasks.end_date) AS "Is overdue"
reports.from_clause: tasks LEFT JOIN users ON tasks.assigned_to=users.id LEFT JOIN task_statuses ON tasks.task_status_id=task_statuses.id
